function.name: request_replacement_card
function.description: Orders a replacement for a verified customer's blocked, lost, or expired card. Pass the card, the delivery the caller chose (standard or express), and confirmed. The tool gives the prices, dates, and the exact questions to ask. Only after the caller clearly says yes, set confirmed to yes.

security_answer.description: The security answer the caller gave when verifying

card.description: Last 4 digits of the card, or debit or credit. Leave out if only one card needs replacing.

delivery.description: As chosen by the caller. Leave out if not chosen yet.

confirmed.description: yes only if the caller clearly said yes to this exact order. Otherwise leave out.
